API

For AI agents: this API as Markdown, or every component in llms-full.txt.

<ray-icon> · RayIcon

setIcons({ name: '<svg…>' }) replaces or adds icons (SVG markup or an SVGElement, drawn with currentColor); iconNames() lists them. Sizes follow the font unless size; --ray-icon-size and --ray-icon-stroke tune the whole system.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
namename reflectsstringRegistered icon name (iconNames()).
sizesize reflectsstringxs…xl or any CSS length. Default: 1em.
labellabelstringAccessible name; without it the icon is decorative (hidden from screen readers).
colorcolor reflectsstringA palette color or any CSS color. Default: the text color.
strokestrokenumberStroke width for stroke icons (default: --ray-icon-stroke, 2).
PartDescription
iconThe icon box.
